lines.en: Do you think that the writer passed his driving test? Why?
lines.cn: 你认为那位作者通过了驾驶考试吗？为什么？

lines.en: I was being tested for a driving licence for the third time.
lines.cn: 这是我第三次参加驾照考试了。

lines.en: I had been asked to drive in heavy traffic and had done so successfully.
lines.cn: 我曾被要求在繁忙的交通中驾驶，而且我也成功完成了这项任务。

lines.en: After having been instructed to drive out of town, I began to acquire confidence.
lines.cn: 在接到“开车离开城镇”的指令后，我逐渐恢复了信心。

lines.en: Sure that I had passed, I was almost beginning to enjoy my test.
lines.cn: 当我确定自己已经通过了考试后，我甚至开始享受这个考试过程了。

lines.en: The examiner must have been pleased with my performance, for he smiled and said, 'Just one more thing Mr. Eames.
lines.cn: 考官一定对我的表现很满意，因为他微笑着对我说：“还有一件事，埃姆斯先生。”

lines.en: Let us suppose that a child suddenly crosses the road in front of you.
lines.cn: 假设突然有一个孩子在你面前横穿马路。

lines.en: As soon as I tap on the window, you must stop within five feet.'
lines.cn: “我一碰到窗户，你就必须在五英尺范围内停下来。”

lines.en: I continued driving and after some time, the examiner tapped loudly.
lines.cn: 我继续开车，过了一会儿，考官突然大声敲了敲车窗。

lines.en: Though the sound could be heard clearly, it took me a long time to react.
lines.cn: 虽然那个声音听得非常清楚，但我还是花了很长时间才做出反应。

lines.en: I suddenly pressed the brake pedal hard and we were both thrown forward.
lines.cn: 我突然猛踩刹车，结果我们俩都被向前甩了出去。

lines.en: The examiner looked at me sadly.
'Mr. Eames,' he said, in a mournful voice, 'you have just killed that child!'
lines.cn: “埃姆斯先生，”他带着悲伤的声音说道，“您刚刚害死了那个孩子！”
